periodLabel: 三国前期，约公元230年作参照；不是已完成考证的逐年行政区划图
namePolicy: 州治及司隶治所优先显示城名；普通据点显示郡级简称；原行政名称保留独立字段。夷洲保留指定游戏名称。
geometryPolicy: Historical longitude and latitude are preserved as source data. Artwork castle centers are display positions, adjusted to spread western regions and reduce crowding while retaining broad directions and the original river bank.
status: 96-point visual preview only; Hainan Zhuya is a requested game expansion; no ROM modification or emulator run
license: CHGIS source records CC BY-NC 4.0; Natural Earth physical geometry public domain; private planning preview only
rejectedOrQualified: CHGIS hvd_115005 安定郡坐标落河北，排除直接用于本版。
CHGIS hvd_115026 巴郡点落奉节，与本版采用的江州治所不符。
CHGIS hvd_116154 云南郡为跨期点，未直接代替云南驿古城点。
CHGIS 一些 years 的末值0是不明或未编定，不能据此断言公元0年废止。
建安郡260年才设；为约230年参照版将前版建安节点重编为豫章。
丹阳郡跨期库点与三国前期治建业的文献有差别，本版按《吕范传》并标明时间。
魏吴江夏、庐江存在分治，本版各取一个代表点，未声称消除异说。
CHGIS庐陵郡点跨越多个时期，未直接作为本版高昌县精确城址。
CHGIS宜都郡点落夷陵，本版按夷道区域另取参考点。
珠官郡古治所采用浦北旧州区域参考，未直接采用今合浦县城跨期点。
九真、日南在CHGIS此查询无结果；本版用文献所记胥浦、朱吾的区域近似位置，不声称精确考古城址。
新增燕郡的州治单独设蓟县点，不把原有范阳据点改成蓟。
新增常山点采用230年前后元氏郡治区域参考，迁真定时点保留年代说明。
CHGIS冯翊郡、陇西郡和辽西郡的跨期点未直接当作230年治所。
保留前版75据点全部位置及显示名称；这是一版三国前期布局样图，旧据点名称仍须逐项按最终剧本年代统一校订。

notRenamed: 范阳郡点是涿县，并非幽州治蓟，不为改标签而将其冒作蓟城。
山阳郡点是昌邑；魏晋兖州治廪丘有迁移记载，此版不沿用汉末州治身份。
魏郡点是邺；冀州治所在邺与信都之间存在迁移，本版不未经年代核实就标为230年州治。
谯郡点是谯县；豫州州治亦有安城等记载，不把所有郡治、别都都标成州治。
下邳的郡名与城名相同，主标签保持下邳；徐州治所迁移时段仍需按剧本细化。
交趾龙编、番禺等交州治所须核对交广分合年代，此版不把所有曾任州治的城市都强行改标。

expansion.chronology: 约230年口径：225年建宁改名及云南、兴古设置，229年武都、阴平取得；不提前加入延熙间的东广汉等郡。
expansion.sunWuChronology: 约230年口径；补入新都、鄱阳、庐陵、宜都、蕲春、临贺、南海、高凉、珠官、九真、日南。临海、建安、东阳、吴兴、始兴等晚置郡不提前加入；珠官按228年改名。

framingPolicy: 全图按全部城标和台湾岛轮廓的投影边界取景；东边收至乐浪、带方城标附近，其余边同样收紧。
stylePolicy: Use the latest image explicitly selected by the user without repainting its terrain or waterways. Retain the accepted side crop and a separate editable layer of 96 city markers and names.
screenGeometryPolicy: Artist-map registration, not a modern geographic projection. Existing longitudes and latitudes remain unchanged; screen positions follow original map landmarks.

coastRefinement.koreaMapping: compact equirectangular registration joined to the original northeast artwork

referenceRegistration.mainland: x=(lon-96)*52, y=(43-lat)*39; artistic approximate placement, then nearby clear land and sprite collision adjustment

crop.policy: Tighter viewport on the existing editable map; unchanged terrain image and city coordinates, automatic label reflow inside the new crop.

selectionPolicy: The latest user-uploaded image is authoritative. Its terrain and waterways are unchanged. Retain the accepted crop and all 96 city names; shift only markers newly landing on water to nearby shore.

layoutExpansion.policy: Artist-map spacing: expand Longyou, western Guanzhong and Yizhou toward available western land; retain broad relative directions and forbid city moves across the drawn rivers. Geographic coordinates and all names are unchanged.

iconPolicy: Original NES 8x8 city tile uniformly scaled 4x to 32x32 pixels. Preserve the original black/white pixel pattern and existing road endpoint anchors. Clamp edge icons inside the image while keeping road endpoints inside their opaque glyphs. City names remain hidden.

terrainPolicy.waterPolicy: Control points are schematic artwork coordinates, not surveyed historic bank lines. Main basin separation is explicit; modern coast and fixed castles are artistic constraints.

hexiCorridor.scope: Retained in this terrain revision; all city positions are frozen at the previous plan.
hexiCorridor.policy: Preserve the existing map crop, 96 cities, names-hidden native 32px sprites and all geographic source coordinates. Separate Qilian mountains southwest of an oasis corridor from the lower northern ridge. Keep the existing river mask.

fixedCityPolicy: Superseded regionally by user-authorized v39 Shandong/Hebei historical-seat corrections. Remaining cities retain v38 anchors.
seaTimePolicy: Accumulated travel events across 220–280, not limited to the base city naming reference year.

terrainReferences.title: 北京大学课程·三国时期全图
中科院地理资源所·珠江三角洲

seaDisplayPolicy: Only historical sea directions represented by existing map cities. The former southern off-map extension is clipped at Rinan. No route numbers, off-map directions or failed plans.

precedingTerrainPolicy.policy: Restore green mountains in the former loess region; add sandy desert west of the northern Yellow River; replace the continuous northern orange mountain wall with open steppe and scattered low green ridges. Preserve fixed cities and water. Stylized topographic reference, not an exact ancient vegetation map.

mountainPolicy: Translate source mountain patches one-for-one without redrawing, scaling, duplicating or adding new mountain artwork. Use generated grass only to fill the lifted original mountain silhouettes. No river, lake or valley-floor geometry edits.

lowerYellowRevision.scope: Only the Yellow River east of full-art x=904; original city positions and all other water features retained.
lowerYellowRevision.historicalPolicy: Han-Wei bank relationships, not modern Yellow River. Mouth on stylized existing coast is approximate.

regionalHistoricalRevision.scope: Shandong, Hebei and necessary adjacent-city layout corrections

moves.seat: 渔阳县，今北京密云一带
moves.reason: 渔阳采用密云附近参考，置蓟东北。

moves.name: 代郡
moves.seat: 代县，今河北蔚县代王城一带
moves.reason: 代郡采用蔚县代王城参考，保留在上谷以西。

moves.name: 魏郡
moves.reason: 魏郡采用邺，置常山元氏以南、濮阳西北。

moves.name: 东平
moves.seat: 寿张（今山东梁山寿张集一带，曹魏治所区域参考）
moves.reason: 曹魏采用寿张区域参考，位济南西南、定陶东北，仍为黄河东南岸。

moves.name: 济阴
moves.seat: 定陶县，今山东菏泽定陶一带
moves.reason: 济阴定陶在山阳昌邑以西，撤销原布局东移。

moves.name: 山阳
moves.seat: 昌邑（今山东巨野南一带）
moves.reason: 山阳采用巨野南昌邑，不采用胶东现代昌邑；与定陶相邻而偏东。

moves.name: 下邳
moves.seat: 下邳（今江苏睢宁古邳一带）
moves.reason: 下邳古邳在郯县西南，恢复这一方向关系。

moves.name: 谯郡
moves.reason: 谯县在今亳州，远在山东诸郡以南；撤销原先近百像素的北移，恢复旧地理草图锚点。
